brain.commentary: Broad risk-off overlay is warranted: every asset shares a stressed cross-asset regime, institutional advisory risk is elevated, and long signals are generally only moderate conviction against sizable expected shortfalls. Preserve capital by materially scaling gross exposure. Fragile signals include BCH, DOGE, XRP, ADA, XLM, ETC, AVAX, and UNI; these combine weak alpha or institutional/liquidity readings with high volatility. LINK is the strongest signal but remains exposed to stress and liquidity constraints.
